method_notes.summary: Coordinates for the named places of Bob Zybach's Elliott State Forest oral-history tours (2017-2018) and the 2018 SWOCC Forest Recreation field trips.

sources_tested.result: WORKED - 36,780 Oregon records, used as the primary geocoder (file dated 2026-07-06)
WORKED but very thin for this area - only 3 of 19 queried places returned a match; used at <=1 request/second with a User-Agent naming America's School Trust Library
WORKED - PLSS section polygons (Willamette Meridian) used to turn township/range/section readings off Bob's maps into coordinates
WORKED - the six field-trip pages and their 2018 itinerary handouts (the numbered/lettered stop lists) were fetched from ORWW

method_notes.method_gnis: Exact name + county (+ feature class or feature_id) match against the USGS GNIS Oregon domestic-names file. GNIS coordinates are reproduced unchanged; no rounding beyond the source precision. For STREAMS the GNIS primary point is the MOUTH, which is often miles from the tour stop - this is stated in every stream record's precision_note.
method_notes.method_map_reading: Bob's four hand-labeled route maps (Maps/Zybach-Ross_2017*.jpg, Zybach-Ross_20181010-10.jpg) carry a PLSS township/range/section grid with the township labels (22S9W ... 25S12W) and section numbers printed. For places with no GNIS or OSM entry, the stop marker was located on a zoomed crop, its section read from the printed grid, and the coordinate taken as the centroid of that section in BLM CadNSDI. Typical accuracy +/-0.5 mi (a section is 1 mi square); markers near a section or township line are flagged with a wider bound. These records are confidence "inferred". The georeference was validated independently: the BLM centroid of T22S R11W sec.35 falls 0.13 mi from the GNIS Dean Mountain summit, which is the summit Bob's map marks with its "Dean Mountain Repeater" symbol in that same section.
method_notes.not_done: No coordinate was invented. 33 places that Bob names on his maps or in the transcripts have lat/lon null and confidence "unresolved"; each carries a precision_note saying why and, where known, which named feature it sits on.
method_notes.stop_labels: stops_here[].stop_label reproduces Bob's own map-stop label and TOC line verbatim from sources/elliott/oral/Oral_History_TOC-2019.pdf. field_trip_stops[].stop_number reproduces the numbering used in his 2018 itinerary handouts (1-10 for Elkhorn Ranch, A-F / A-E / A-D for the others; unnumbered trips carry the stop name).
